scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
I think we're really
fortunate to be able to
live in such a beautiful
and peaceful city like this.
scripts.translation:
[智元]
能住在这么美丽又宁静的城市里，我觉得我们真幸运。

scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
It's just so nice to
have this pleasant weather,
these lush gardens and to
meet all of these kind people.
Lighthalzen is like Asgard
in Midgard, heaven on earth~
scripts.translation:
[智元]
天气宜人，花园郁郁葱葱，身边的人也这么友善，真好。
里希塔乐镇简直就是米德加尔特的阿斯加德，人间天堂~

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
It gets harder for me
to move around as I get
older. That's understandable
for an elderly person, right?
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
^333333*唉...*^000000
年纪越大，行动越不方便。人老了，这也正常，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
Just the other day, these
hoodlums in black suits
were yelling at me to get out
of their way. But of course,
I didn't move quickly enough.
So what did they do to me?
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
前几天，几个穿黑西装的混混冲我嚷嚷，叫我让路。可我这把年纪，哪能一下就挪开？
你猜，他们对我做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
They punched me.
Right in the womb!
I know that I'm not
pregnant, but that's
besides the point. Never hit
a lady, especially an old one!
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
他们竟然打了我一拳，就打在小腹上！我知道自己没怀孕，可这不是重点。
哪能打女人，尤其是我这样的老太太！

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
Sweety, isn't it
nice to be together
under this beautiful
sunlight? It's perfect
for our date. Ahhhh~
scripts.translation:
[露丝]
亲爱的，在这么美的阳光下，跟你待在一起，是不是特别好？最适合我们约会了。
啊~

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
I'm so happy to be
with you. I feel like
I'm just melting with
happiness. Oh, I love
you so much, Oyoung.
scripts.translation:
[露丝]
和你在一起，我好开心，简直要被幸福融化了。
哦，五荣，我好爱你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...
This couple is
really headed for
Cloud 9, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...这对情侣简直幸福得飘上天了，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
Girl, you look like
you're comin' down with
the love bug. But there's
only one prescription for
this ailment, ooooh yeah...
scripts.translation:
[五荣]
宝贝，你好像染上相思病了。可这病只有一种解药，哦，没错...

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
You need yo'self
your daily dose of
vitamin O-YOUNG.
And your lips look like
they got vitamin deficiency.
I better take care of that~
scripts.translation:
[五荣]
你得每天补充一剂“五荣维生素”。你的嘴唇看起来也缺维生素了，我得帮你好好补补~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sweet Sister!
I don't know what's
more mind boggling--
The fact that he used
that line or the fact that
it's actually working...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！我真不知道哪件事更离谱——他竟然说得出这种情话，还是这种情话竟然管用...

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
I think ''Lighthalzen'' is
supposed to mean ''crest of
light,'' though I hear that this
city was actually named after
somebody. Who knows for sure?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
“里希塔乐镇”好像是“光辉之冠”的意思。不过，也听说这座城其实是以某个人的名字命名的。
谁知道究竟是怎么回事呢？

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
Still, it's a fitting
name for the wealthiest
and most luxurious city in
all the Schwarzwald Republic.
So how do you like this place?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
不过，这名字确实配得上修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国最富裕、最奢华的城市。
你觉得这里怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Sung]
When I grow up, I want
to become such a great
person that they'll make
a statue of me, just like
those statues over there.
scripts.translation:
[成]
等我长大了，也要成为伟大的人，让大家给我立座雕像，就像那边那些一样。

scripts.text:
[Sung]
Then people would be like,
''Hey yo. That statue. That
guy must have been great!''
Just thinking about that
makes me feel so good!
scripts.translation:
[成]
到时候，人们就会说：“嘿，看那座雕像！那个人一定很了不起！”
光想想就好开心！

scripts.text:
[Sung]
That's it. I'm gonna
grow up as soon as I can.
Ooh, and I better grow tall
and handsome so my statue
will be even more awesome.
Yeah. Yeah, good idea, Sung...
scripts.translation:
[成]
决定了，我要赶快长大！还得长得又高又帅，这样我的雕像就更威风了。
嗯，嗯，好主意，成...

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
There are too many
loving couples in this city.
Cuddling and kissing and
hugging and necking. It's...
It's utterly distasteful.
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
这城里恩恩爱爱的情侣太多了，搂搂抱抱、亲亲我我的。
真是...真是令人作呕。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I can't believe the
indecency I see everyday
near my own home. Don't
they know better than to be
so affectionate in places
where the public can see them?!
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
每天在自家附近都能看到这种不雅行为，简直难以置信。
他们难道不知道，在大庭广众之下这么亲热，太不像话了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
Fortunately for the
world, I'm a bulwark
of morality. In fact, I have
no need for a woman. All
I need are my ship models,
teen novels and dominoes.
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
幸好，这世界还有我这样坚守道德的人。我根本不需要女人，只要有船模、青少年小说和多米诺骨牌就够了。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I'm a completely well
adjusted individual, which
is why the authorities should
listen to me when I tell them
to arrest couples for indecency!
Hand holding. Have they no shame?!
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
我可是个完全正常的人，所以，当局就该听我的，把那些举止不雅的情侣抓起来！
竟然牵手。他们就不知羞耻吗？！

scripts.text:
[Janice]
Oh no, I think I got
lost again. The roads
here are so confusing!
I've lived here for such
a long time and I still
can't find my way around...
scripts.translation:
[珍妮丝]
哎呀，我好像又迷路了。这里的路太难认了！
住了这么久，我还是分不清方向...

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
Walking side by side
with you like this reminds
me of the old days. Back
then, everyone was jealous
that I had such a beautiful
woman by my side. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[埃尔默·基斯]
像这样跟你并肩散步，就让我想起从前。那时，大家都羡慕我，身边有个这么漂亮的女人。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
You're still the most
precious sight to these
old eyes, my dear. I'm
really lucky to be with you.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔默·基斯]
亲爱的，我这双老眼里，你依然是最珍贵的风景。能与你相伴，我真幸运。

scripts.text:
[Margie Keays]
Oh darling, the
weather is so nice
and pleasant today.
I'm really glad we
decided to go take
a walk together~
scripts.translation:
[玛吉·基斯]
哦，亲爱的，今天天气真好，舒服极了。幸好我们决定一起出来散步~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
...

[Maivi]
Ah...
I just had the nicest
nap. This nice weather
never fails to relax me.
The air here is so clean,
not like that Einbroch~
scripts.translation:
[麦维]
啊...刚才这一觉睡得真舒服。好天气总能让人放松。
这里的空气真干净，哪像艾音布罗克~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
This clean, pristine
environment is all thanks
to the Rekenber Corporation.
It's incredible what they can
do with technology now, isn't
it? Ahhh, it's so peaceful~
scripts.translation:
[麦维]
这么洁净的环境，全靠雷肯贝尔公司。如今他们用科技能做到的事，真是不可思议，对吧？
啊，真宁静~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Excuse me, but are you
a tourist? Well, welcome
to Lighthalzen! This city
has everything we need,
but it can be a little too
quiet and uneventful here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
请问，你是游客吗？欢迎来到里希塔乐镇！
这里什么都有，就是有时候太安静，没什么新鲜事。

scripts.text: Have you lived in here long?
scripts.translation: 你在这里住很久了吗？

scripts.text: I agree.
scripts.translation: 我也这么觉得

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你听说过连环杀手吗？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, our family has
lived in this city for a
long time, starting with
my great grandfather. Let's
see, my family's been here
for about two hundred years.
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
是啊，从我曾祖父那一辈起，我们家就在这座城里生活了。
让我想想，大概有两百年了吧。

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You'd be surprised how
many people stay in their
hometowns. Even if you do
leave, though, you can always
come back. It wouldn't be your hometown if you couldn't, right?
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
一直留在家乡的人，多得会让你吃惊。就算离开了，也总能回来。
要是连回来都不行，还算什么家乡，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, the atmosphere
can get pretty listless
around here. But still,
there are plenty of nice
sights to enjoy here in
Lighthalzen, so look around~
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
是啊，这里有时候确实有点沉闷。不过，里希塔乐镇还是有不少美景，四处逛逛吧~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You mean the Serial
Axe Murderer? I thought
that was an old ghost story.
Hm. I think that lady inside
the Weapon Shop would
know more about that tale...
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
你说那个连环斧头杀人犯？我还以为那只是个老鬼故事。
嗯，武器店里的那位女士，应该更了解这个故事...

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
You know what I noticed?
The guards at the border
to the slum seem distracted
sometimes. I made use of one
of their less attentive moments
and basically jumped the fence!
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
你知道我发现了什么吗？贫民窟入口的卫兵，有时候会走神。
我就趁他们没留意，翻过围栏进去了！

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
But once I was in the 
slums, I was pretty bored.
There really isn't much to
do there. Which makes me
wonder... Why guard it?
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
不过，进了贫民窟以后，才发现挺无聊的，没什么可干的。
这就让我纳闷了...干吗还要派人守着？

scripts.text:
[Joyce]
I can sense your
longing look within
the depths of my heart,
beating faster and faster
with a feverish passion~
scripts.translation:
[乔伊斯]
你的目光满含渴望，我内心深处都能感受到。我的心随着这炽热的激情，跳得越来越快~

scripts.text:
[Dan Song]
Those eyes of yours...
So pure and so deep,
like glimmering pools
of light. So, so beautiful...
scripts.translation:
[丹·宋]
你的双眼...那么清澈，那么深邃，宛如闪着微光的水潭。
真美，真美...

scripts.text:
[Collins]
I really wish that my
son will be able to join
the Rekenber Corporation.
They certainly provide the
best jobs in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
我真希望我儿子能加入里希塔乐镇的雷肯贝尔公司。
他们那里的工作待遇绝对是全镇最好的。

scripts.text:
[Collins]
Although they're a large,
major corporation, it's
almost impossible to get
employed by them. How
do people get hired there
in the first place anyway?
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
他们虽是大公司，可想进去工作却难如登天。别人到底是怎么应聘上的呢？

scripts.text:
[Villagomez]
I just step out to get
a haircut and now I'm
lost. Boy oh boy, I hope
I don't keep my family
waiting. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[维拉戈梅斯]
我不过出门剪个头发，竟然就迷路了。唉，希望别让家里人等太久。^333333*唉...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
Have you ever seen the
people who work in that big
corporation over there? I think
their employees are all a bit
off kilter for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
你见过那边大公司的员工吗？不知怎么回事，我总觉得他们都有点不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
I haven't been there
myself, but something
strange is happening with
all the people who work there.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
我自己没去过那里，但在那家公司工作的人身上似乎发生了一些奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
The youth in this city
have no appreciation for
their elders. I've worked
so hard to help build this
city for so many years and
this is the thanks I get?
scripts.translation:
[毛罗]
这座城市的年轻人根本不尊重长辈。
我辛苦多年帮助建设这座城市，得到的却是这种回报？

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
Bah! If it weren't for
us, Lighthalzen wouldn't
be as prosperous as it is
today! Those kids don't
know that they owe their
lives of luxury to us...
scripts.translation:
[毛罗]
哼！要不是我们，里希塔乐镇今天不会这么繁荣！
那些孩子根本不知道他们的富裕生活是我们给的...

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
Good looks. Intelligence.
Excellent manners. A strong,
manly chin and overpowering,
piercing eyes. Perfectly balanced passion and charisma. All the
good things that ladies want.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
相貌英俊，头脑聪明，举止优雅。下巴棱角分明，充满男子气概，目光锐利，摄人心魄。
热情与魅力恰到好处。女人想要的一切优点，都齐了。

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
But enough about me. Let's
discuss how sorry I should
feel for any other man living
in Lighthalzen. They don't hold
a candle to my studliness~
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
好了，不说我了。聊聊里希塔乐镇其他男人有多值得同情吧。
论男性魅力，他们跟我根本没法比~

scripts.text:
[Jade]
I've heard that there's a
strange kingdom out there
that's basically ruled by
magic and swords, where
adventurers are enlisted
for the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
听说外面有个奇怪的王国，主要依靠剑与魔法来治理，还会招募冒险者为大家谋福祉。

scripts.text:
[Jade]
So are you from
Rune-Midgarts?
What do you think
of our city with its
advanced technology
and economy? Huh...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
你是从卢恩·米德加兹来的吗？我们这座城科技先进，经济发达，你觉得怎么样？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Someday, I'd like
to go visit the land
where you came from.
It sounds so fantastic
and romantic in a way...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
将来有机会，我也想去你的家乡看看。听起来那么奇幻，又有几分浪漫...

scripts.text:
[Khramptd]
The land around here
is some pretty expensive
property. Yes, it's perfect
for building my awesome palace!
I don't have enough funds at the
moment, but the day will come~
scripts.translation:
[克拉姆普特]
这一带的地价可不便宜。不过，正适合建造我那气派的宫殿！
眼下钱还不够，但那一天总会来的~

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
Sure, I sell a lot
of flowers here, but
the lease that this city
makes me pay cuts into
my profits. It's almost not
worth renting this property.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
我在这里卖的花是挺多，可交给城里的租金，把利润吃掉了不少。租下这个地方，几乎都不划算了。

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
I pay such a ridiculous
amount for the lease and the
laws here won't let me raise
the price of my flowers. Why
are the city officials so greedy?
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
租金高得离谱，这里的法律还不许我提高花价。城里的官员怎么就这么贪心？

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
......
That lady, working
for that one company,
Kafra, Mafra or whatever.
She certainly is very charming.
scripts.translation:
[华莱士]
......
在那家公司工作的姑娘，就是卡普拉、马普拉什么的那个公司。她可真迷人。

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
Now, if I were
thirty years younger...
Wait! I'm a rich and powerful
man. I could ask her out now.
Hm? What's that look for?
scripts.translation:
[华莱士]
要是我年轻三十岁...等等！我有钱有势，现在也能约她出来呀。
嗯？你那是什么眼神？

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
Would you like to
make a donation
to help the hungry?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你好，年轻人~
你愿意捐款帮助饥饿的人吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Now, you can donate 1 to
30,000 zeny that will be used
to support the poor and feed
starving children. If you wish
to cancel, please enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你可以捐 1 到 30,000 Zeny，用于救济穷人，让挨饿的孩子们吃饱。
想取消的话，请输入“0”。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Please enter a value
from 1 to 30,000 in
order to make a donation
to the needy, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
年轻人，请输入 1 到 30,000 之间的金额，为有需要的人捐款。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
How disappointing,
but I'm sure you have
your reasons. Well, when
you can afford to give to
the needy, you're welcome
to come back at any time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
真让人失望，不过，相信你也有自己的难处。等你有余力帮助穷人时，欢迎随时再来。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Thank you so much
for your {0} zeny donation.
I promise that your money
will be put to good use in
benefiting the poor and needy.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
非常感谢你捐出 {0} Zeny。我保证，这笔钱会妥善用于帮助贫困和有需要的人。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Still, I'm just a little
disappointed. An adventurer
like you should be donating
as much as you possibly can...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
不过，我还是有点失望。像你这样的冒险者，应该尽自己的能力多捐一些...

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
So far, I've received
a total of {0} zeny in
donations. I'm glad to see
that there are still kind and
generous people in the world.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
到目前为止，我总共收到了 {0} Zeny 的捐款。看到世上还有这么多善良慷慨的人，我真高兴。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
This should be enough
to send to the Poor Relief
Organization. Please accept
this small gift as a token of
my gratitude, adventurer. Bless
you, youngster and take care.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
这些钱应该够送交贫困救济组织了。冒险者，请收下这份小礼物，作为我的谢意。
愿你平安，年轻人，保重。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
I understand. Still,
keep in mind that when
you give from your heart,
you will be rewarded tenfold.
Though I admit, the benefits
aren't always readily apparent.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
我明白。不过，请记住，发自内心地付出，会得到十倍的回报。
当然，我承认，这份回报未必马上就看得见。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
You seem to be fairly
well-off. Money is good
to have, but be careful not
to become obsessed with it.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你好，年轻人~你看起来颇为富裕。
有钱是好事，可别太执着于钱财。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
When you have the chance,
please show your generosity
towards others who may be
much less fortunate than you.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
有机会的话，请慷慨地帮助那些境遇远不如你的人。

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
Sure, manliness is quite
attractive, but I think women
appreciate a guy who could
sympathize and talk with them
a little more. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[拉库梅特]
男子气概是很有吸引力。不过，我觉得女人更喜欢能体谅她们、愿意多陪她们聊聊的男人。
你说呢？

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
I might not be like Sefith,
but I guess I've got a cute
smile, a good personality and
I'm a dandy to boot. Hopefully,
my honesty and loyalty will
help me find someone good.
scripts.translation:
[拉库梅特]
我可能不像塞菲斯那么出众，不过，我笑起来挺可爱，性格也好，还很会打扮。
希望我的真诚和忠心，能帮我找到合适的人。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you are experiencing
any sort of inconvenience,
please do not hesitate and
let us know right away.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
如果您遇到任何不便，请随时告诉我们。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Please use the stairs
at the northern end to
go downstairs so that you
can go to the Front Desk.
Thank you and I hope that
you enjoy your stay here.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
请从北侧的楼梯下楼，前往前台。
谢谢，祝您入住愉快。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Michael]
OoooOoh~
Soooo comfortable.
Don't want to wake up.
Don't want to get up.
Ever again. OoOoooh...
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·迈克尔]
哦哦哦~真舒服。
不想醒来，不想起床，再也不想。
哦哦哦...

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
This hotel is nice
and comfortable, but
to be quite frank, the
drinks here are horrible.
They're unfit for drinking
men such as myself.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
这家酒店不错，住着也舒服。不过，老实说，这里的酒实在难喝。
像我这样的酒客，可喝不惯。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
If this is the best hotel,
I expect them to provide me
with the best alcohol. When
I stay at a hotel, that's what
I want. To spend the entire
day not being sober.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
既然是最好的酒店，就该给我最好的酒。住酒店，我图的就是这个：一整天都醉着，别醒过来。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
It looks like that
today I'll be heading
out to the bar again...
I just wish there were
someplace quieter to drink.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
看来今天我又得去酒吧了...
我真希望能有个更安静的地方喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
This is the Couple Suite.
A single can also check
in here, but our hotel will
prioritize couples when
assigning this room.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
这里是情侣套房。单人也可以入住，不过，安排这间房时，我们会优先考虑情侣。

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
This chair looks
very nice, but it really
chills my bottom. Brr...!
It's a might uncomfortable!
scripts.translation:
[田上]
这椅子看着挺漂亮，可坐着真冰屁股。嘶...！怪不舒服的！

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
You know what the
perfect chair would
be like? It would be
plush and have electronic
massage and heating controls...
scripts.translation:
[田上]
你知道最理想的椅子该是什么样吗？要软软的，还得能调节电动按摩和加热功能...

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
Aaahhh Oooooh~
It's sooooo comfy~
The air's so fresh and
this couch is so plush...
Why can't home be like this?
scripts.translation:
[本·艾伦]
啊啊，哦哦~真舒服~
空气清新，沙发又这么软...家里怎么就不能这样呢？

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
I've been in those other
hotels and let me tell you,
this place is the best ever.
After a night's sleep over
here, I feel like a new man!
scripts.translation:
[本·艾伦]
别的酒店我也住过，我跟你说，这里绝对是最好的。在这儿睡上一晚，整个人都像重新活过来了！

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Oh sweet jiminy...
That Kafra Lady is so hot.
What a body. And those glasses.
I just gotta ask her out somehow.
scripts.translation:
[竖琴]
天哪...那位卡普拉小姐真性感。那身材，还有那副眼镜。
我一定得想办法约她出来。

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Hm, but what should
I do? A love letter? Naw,
that's kind of outdated.
Argh, I can't think! Just
looking at her makes me feel
so happy! Praise be to Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[竖琴]
嗯，该怎么做呢？写情书？不，那有点过时了。
啊，想不出来！光是看着她就好幸福！赞美卡普拉！

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
''Hospitality with a smile
and total devotion to your
comfort.'' That's our motto
in the Royal Dragon Hotel.
Please inquire at the front
desk if you wish to check in.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
“微笑待客，全心为您营造舒适体验。”这是皇家龙酒店的服务宗旨。
如需入住，请到前台咨询。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Welcome to the
Royal Dragon Hotel Bar.
How about a nice night
cap before going to bed?
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
欢迎光临皇家龙酒店酒吧。睡前来杯小酒，怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you're looking
for a friend, you
can almost always
make one in this bar.
Alcohol certainly is the
grease for social gears.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
想交朋友的话，在这间酒吧几乎总能交到。酒可真是社交的润滑剂。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Oh yeah. I love-love-love
bars. If I don't come here
for the booze, then I'm here
for all these beautiful ladies.
scripts.translation:
[八]
没错，我最最最喜欢酒吧了。不为喝酒来，也是为这里的美女们来。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Weird. It's the very first
time I've tried this place's
rum, but doesn't it taste like
pure sexiness to you? Huh...
Oh well, back to schmoozin'
with all the hot chicks~
scripts.translation:
[八]
真奇妙，我还是头一次喝这里的朗姆酒。你不觉得这味道简直性感极了吗？嗯...
算了，继续找美女们搭讪去~

scripts.text:
[Duff]
Hey, you're from
Rune-Midgarts, right?
Please make yourself
at home while you're here
in Lighthalzen and have
yourself a good time.
scripts.translation:
[达夫]
嘿，你是从卢恩·米德加兹来的吧？在里希塔乐镇，就像在自己家一样，尽情玩吧。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I hate it when guys
just sidle up and sort
of just skip Steps One
and Two. And before you
get all weird, Step Three
is ''Ask for my phone number.''
scripts.translation:
[罗娜]
我最烦那些一凑过来，就跳过第一步和第二步的男人。
先别想歪，第三步只是“问我要电话号码”。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I would just really
appreciate it if one
nice boy would just
talk to me for real.
scripts.translation:
[罗娜]
只要有个好男孩能认认真真跟我聊聊，我就很开心了。

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
I don't believe it...
This unlucky streak
will never end, will it?
I lost all my Apples
playing Dice today.
Again. Oh man...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲尔德]
真不敢相信...这倒霉运就没完没了吗？今天玩骰子，又把所有苹果都输光了。
又是这样。唉...

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
Okay. Okay.
If I just keep
playing, eventually
I'll win. I mean, that's
the way the odds work, right?
Even when they're against me...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲尔德]
好吧，好吧。只要一直玩下去，总会赢的。
概率不就是这么回事吗？就算现在对我不利...

scripts.text:
[Terry]
I'm not big on drinking,
but the atmosphere in this
place is really nice. The
music they play is always
smooth and relaxing...
scripts.translation:
[特里]
我不怎么爱喝酒，不过，这里的气氛真好。放的音乐总是轻柔舒缓，让人放松...

scripts.text:
[Terry]
Yeah, this is a real cozy
joint. I recommend it to
all you tourists, actually.
Now why don't you kick
back and chill with me?
scripts.translation:
[特里]
是啊，这地方真舒服。我推荐所有游客都来坐坐。
不如陪我一起歇会儿，放松一下？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
You see that guy?
That guy over there is
always looking at me.
I wonder... Does he want
to ask me out or something?
scripts.translation:
[圣]
你看到那个人了吗？就是那边那个，总在看我。
难道...他想约我出去？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, if he does,
shouldn't he have
more guts? Or are 
you boys much more
shy than I think you are?
scripts.translation:
[圣]
要真是这样，他不该大胆一点吗？还是说，你们男孩子比我想的还害羞？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, he is sort of
cute. Geez, this would
be so much easier if he
would just come up and
start talking to me...
scripts.translation:
[圣]
他倒是挺可爱的。唉，他要是直接过来找我说话，不就简单多了...

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Isn't the weather nice
today? All this sunlight
will dry these clothes
quickly and give them
a fresh, lovely scent.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
今天天气真好，是吧？阳光这么足，衣服很快就能晒干，还会带上一股清新的香味。

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, an adventurer from
Rune-Midgarts, are you?
How do you like our city?
If you have any questions,
feel free to ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，你是从卢恩·米德加兹来的冒险者吧？觉得我们这座城怎么样？
有什么想知道的，尽管问我。

scripts.text: Well, I have nothing to ask...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没什么要问的...

scripts.text: Any news or rumors?
scripts.translation: 有什么新闻或传闻吗？

scripts.text: I like laundry too.
scripts.translation: 我也喜欢洗衣服

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, really?
Well, if you've traveled
all over the world, maybe
you've found a place just
like Lighthalzen, so maybe
you're already comfortable?
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，是吗？你走遍了世界各地，也许到过跟里希塔乐镇差不多的地方，所以已经习惯这里了？

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Well, things have
been pretty peaceful
for the past few years.
The only rumor floating
around is about some
weird axe murderer...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
这几年都挺太平的。外面流传的，就只有那个奇怪的连环斧头杀人犯的故事...

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, that's wonderful!
I so love doing hand
laundry, though I'm not
quite sure why. Oh well~
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，太好了！我特别喜欢亲手洗衣服，虽然自己也不知道为什么。
算啦~

scripts.text:
[Berru]
Daddy...! Waaaaah~!
I wanna see my Daddy!
scripts.translation:
[贝鲁]
爸爸...！哇啊啊~！
我想见爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Berru, I don't 
think Daddy's coming
home tonight. Come on,
we should go to bed.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
贝鲁，爸爸今晚可能不会回来了。来，我们该睡觉了。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
No, I'm not gonna
sleep till Daddy gets
home! He said he'll
bring us candy tonight!
You go sleep first, Pilia!
scripts.translation:
[贝鲁]
不要！爸爸没回家，我就不睡！他说今晚要给我们带糖果的！
皮莉娅，你先去睡吧！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Where's our Daddy?
He said he found a
good job, but we haven't
heard from him since then...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
^333333*唉...*^000000
爸爸在哪儿呢？他说找到了一份好工作，可从那以后，我们就再没他的消息了...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
What's taking him
so long? I hope Daddy
comes back home soon.
Come on, Berru, don't cry.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
他怎么这么久还没回来？
希望爸爸能快点回家。
别哭了，贝鲁。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
^333333*Sob...*^000000
But I'm hungry
and I miss Daddy!

[Pilia]
Uncle Togii from
next door hasn't
come back either...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
隔壁的托吉叔叔也还没回来...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Hmm? Oh, I'm sorry,
but my little brother
just won't stop crying.
I'm sorry if we're loud...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
嗯？哦，对不起，我弟弟一直哭个不停。要是吵到你了，真不好意思...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Our daddy goes to work
somewhere far away. He
finally has a good job, but
sometimes we don't hear
from him for days. We get
really worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
爸爸在很远的地方工作。他好不容易找到一份好工作，可有时候一连好几天都没消息。
我们真的很担心他。

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
My brother Berru always
misses him a lot. I don't
know how to make him
stop crying! What do I do?
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
我弟弟贝鲁总是特别想爸爸。我都不知道怎么哄他不哭了！该怎么办呢？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Please...
My child is starving...
Would you give me
some money?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
求求你...我的孩子快饿死了...能给我一点钱吗？

scripts.text: Give him some money.
scripts.translation: 给他一些钱

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I appreciate your
kindness, but it also
looks like you're in need
of zeny, too. Would you
like to join me?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
谢谢你的好意，不过，看起来你自己也缺 Zeny。要不要和我一起乞讨？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you go,
take this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给你，拿着吧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Thank you so much.
I have nothing to offer you
in exchange, but I can share
a story with you and impart
some of the wisdom I've
learned over the years.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
太感谢了。我没什么能回报你的，不过，可以给你讲个故事，分享一些这些年悟出的道理。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Everyone's been in
a situation where you
sometimes you feel that
you have to make a choice
between doing the right thing
and doing what you want, right?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
有时候，做正确的事和做自己想做的事，似乎只能选一个。这种情况，谁都遇到过，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
You may feel trapped.
Well, let me tell you, when
it comes to a problem, all
the solutions available to
you aren't always obvious.
So just calm down and think.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你也许会觉得走投无路。不过，面对问题时，并不是所有解决办法都能一眼看出来。
所以，先静下心来，好好想想。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What you can see and
understand might not match
with reality. Like the stars that are always there, but not visible
during the day, we'll always have hope, even if we can't see it.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你所看到、所理解的，未必就是全部事实。就像星星一直都在，只是白天看不见。
希望也始终存在，即使我们看不到它。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Hmm...?
You seem surprised~
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
嗯...？你好像很惊讶~

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I sort of believe in fate and
sort of don't. Let me explain
it this way. I take life day by
day, with each day covering its
own spectrum with miracle on one end and tragedy on the other.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
我有些相信命运，又有些不信。这么说吧，我一天一天地过日子。
每一天都充满可能，一端是奇迹，另一端是悲剧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
So each day has the capacity
for experiences that can be
good, bad or both. I believe
each person can take an 
active role in shaping their
destiny, day by day.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
所以，每天都可能遇到好事、坏事，也可能两者都有。
我相信，每个人都能主动塑造自己的命运，一天一天地改变它。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Now, there may be certain
things that you can't control,
but even a pessimist might
be able to agree that this
is a world that not only has
tragedy, but miracles as well.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
当然，有些事不由你控制。不过，即使再悲观的人也该承认，这世界不只有悲剧，也有奇迹。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Stand up when you're down
and live your life with passion. The capacity for miracles will
always be there and know that
you can be someone else's
miracle. Isn't that wonderful?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
跌倒了就站起来，满怀热情地生活。奇迹始终有可能发生，你也可以成为别人生命中的奇迹。
这不是很美好吗？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't believe me?
Well, you'll see for
yourself, youngster.
There's much good in you.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
不信吗？年轻人，你总会亲眼看到的。你心里有很多善意。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Anger. People deal with
it in different ways. Some
suppress it. Some relish it.
Some fear being angry. Now,
to be simple, let's say there
are two kinds of anger.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
说到愤怒，每个人应对的方式都不一样。有人压抑它，有人享受它，也有人害怕生气。
简单点说，我们把愤怒分成两种。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The first is the kind that
isn't so productive. More of
a frustration that you can let
go. Someone cut you off on the
freeway or a friend innocently forgot your birthday? No biggie.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第一种没什么益处，更像是可以放下的烦躁。比如有人开车抢了你的道，或者朋友无意间忘了你的生日。
这些都没什么大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't let this kind of
anger get to you or you'll
look like a loser. Think of
the big picture and if you're
still upset, vent appropriately. Be honest without hurting anyone.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
别被这种怒气左右，不然只会显得很没出息。把眼光放远一点。
如果还是生气，就用合适的方式宣泄。坦诚表达，但别伤害任何人。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger
is righteous anger. You've
been wronged and need 
some form of retribution. 
Just don't misdirect your anger
and respond appropriately.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二种是义愤。你受了不公正的对待，需要讨个公道。
但别迁怒于人，要用恰当的方式回应。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger is
righteous anger. You've been
wronged and need some form
of retribution. Remember to
make appropriate confrontations
and don't misdirect your rage.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二种是义愤。你受了不公正的对待，需要讨个公道。
记得用恰当的方式据理力争，别把怒火发泄到无关的人身上。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Getting into a fight with
righteous anger, say to protect
someone dear to you, will make
you a hero. Fighting with anger
born of frustration will make you a bully. Know the difference.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
出于义愤而战，比如为了保护你珍视的人，会让你成为英雄。可只是因为不顺心就动手，只会让你成为恶霸。
要分清两者的区别。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What's wrong?
It might be a lot
to take in, I know.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
怎么了？我知道，一下子讲这么多，可能不容易消化。

scripts.text:
[Reuben]
Someday...
Someday I just gotta
become a train conductor
and just get outta here!
I really hate this place!
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]
总有一天...总有一天，我一定要当上列车长，离开这里！
我真讨厌这个地方！

scripts.text:
[Reuben]]
Wh-whoa...!
Did you just hear
me talk to myself?
Crud! Don't be so nosy!
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]]
哇...哇！你听见我刚才自言自语了？
该死！别多管闲事！

scripts.text:
[Reuben]
Hey. What are
you doing just
looking at me?
I don't know you
from Adam, so get lost~
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]
喂，你盯着我干吗？我根本不认识你，走开~

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
Am I just getting
paranoid? I really
think that some of
the people I know
are disappearing
for no good reason!
scripts.translation:
[圣文]
难道是我太多疑了？我真的觉得，有些认识的人，莫名其妙就消失了！

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
I mean, all of my close
friends are all alright,
but I'm starting not to see
certain acquaintances and
familiar faces. Maybe I'm
just thinking too much...
scripts.translation:
[圣文]
我的好友们倒都没事，可有些熟人、常见的面孔，最近都看不到了。
也许只是我想多了...

scripts.text:
[Shayna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Oh, you poor
darling girl...

[Cenku Dekdam]
Man, if you were
gonna take this whole
city and then sell it, what
do you think Lighthalzen's
price tag would be, eh?
scripts.translation:
[岑库·德克丹]
老兄，要是把整座里希塔乐镇拿来卖，你觉得能卖多少钱？

scripts.text:
[Cenku Dekdam]
I mean, this city
is basically just made
of money. Money is what
makes this city such a nice
and pleasant place to live.
scripts.translation:
[岑库·德克丹]
这座城简直就是用钱堆起来的。正是钱，才让这里的生活这么美好舒适。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
Greetings, adventurer.
I'm Angela, a social
worker for the Poor
Relief Organization.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
你好，冒险者。我叫安吉拉，是贫困救济组织的社工。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've noticed that the
people living here have
extremely bad health and
it's not just because of
their circumstances.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我发现，这里的居民健康状况极差，而且不只是生活困苦造成的。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've filed a report
to my superiors, but
they haven't sent me
a response yet for some
reason. I'm starting to get
a little worried about this...
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我已经向上级提交了报告，可不知为什么，一直没收到回复。我开始有些担心了...

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Must work...
Must focus...
Resist sleepiness...
Why do I keep coming
here? Ugh, h-horrible.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
得工作...得集中精神...不能睡着...
我怎么老来这里？唉，真...真糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Hey youngster. You wanted
adventuring advice? Okay.
Um. Hm. Always. Brush.
Your teeth. Brush them
everyday. Oh, and don't
forget to floss, either.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
嘿，年轻人。你想听点冒险建议？好吧。
呃，嗯。一定。要。刷牙。每天都要刷。
哦，也别忘了用牙线。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Now it's time for me
to head back to work.
I'll see you later, kid.
Sorry my advice was so
lame-- I couldn't think of
anything else to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
该回去工作了。回头见，小家伙。
抱歉，建议太没用了——我实在想不出还有什么能告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
So, the novel I ordered from
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
just recently arrived. It's real good, by the guy who wrote
''Roda Frog Adventure''
years ago. Remember?
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
我从卢恩·米德加兹王国订的小说，最近刚送到。写得真不错，作者就是几年前写《罗达蛙冒险》的那个人。
你还记得吧？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Anyway, this new book,
''Where the Red Plant Grows''
is up for the Yggdrasilberry
Award. I... I don't know why
I was compelled to share that
with you. Seriously, I don't...
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
这本新书《红草生长的地方》，正在角逐天地树果实奖。
我...我也不知道为什么非要把这事告诉你。真的，我不知道...

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
...

[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello?

[Ellette]
...Oh! Everyone!
I just completed
another one! Hooray!
scripts.translation:
[艾莱特]
...哦！大家快看！我又完成一个了！万岁！

scripts.text:
[All other Employees]
Wh-what?!
No way, not again!
scripts.translation:
[其他所有员工]
什...什么？！不会吧，怎么又完成了！

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
Are you even human?
You must have some
secret for that much
productivity. It's weird...
scripts.translation:
[利卡尔]
你真的是人吗？效率这么高，一定有什么秘诀吧。太奇怪了...

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
Oh, come on.
Maybe I'm a little
good at this, but there's
no way I can beat Cenku.
scripts.translation:
[艾莱特]
哎呀，别这样。也许我确实挺擅长这个，可怎么也比不过岑库。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Just out of, oh I dunno,
curiosity, which word do
you like better? ''Uber-Cool''
or ''Reality?'' Pick one~
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
只是出于，呃，怎么说呢，好奇吧。你更喜欢哪个词：“超酷”还是“现实”？选一个~

scripts.text: Uber-Cool
scripts.translation: 超酷

scripts.text: Reality
scripts.translation: 现实

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Oh yeah? Me too!
Yeah, we got the same
outlook on life. If you don't
mind, I'd like to shake
your hand, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
哦，是吗？我也是！看来我们的人生观一样。
冒险者，不介意的话，握个手吧。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Reality, eh?
Well, I agree that
being realistic has its
perks, I'm more of a dreamer.
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
现实，是吧？我承认，务实有务实的好处，不过，我更像个梦想家。

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
So... Very broke.
Why did I spend so much
money on wine, women and
song? I regret it all, all the
pleasure I've had this month.
Yes, it was too much pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[利卡尔]
穷...穷死了。我干吗在吃喝玩乐上花那么多钱？
这个月的享乐，现在全都后悔了。没错，玩得太过头了。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
That's what happens
when you're irresponsible
with your money. You really
should read this ''Anybody
Can Be Rich'' book.
scripts.translation:
[宁霍塞]
这就是乱花钱的下场。你真该读读这本《人人都能致富》。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
At long last, I've finally
bought my own home. You
should invest your money for
your future too! Read this,
''Anybody Can Be Rich!''
It's such a great book!
scripts.translation:
[宁霍塞]
终于，我买下自己的房子了！你也该为未来投资！
读读这本《人人都能致富》吧，写得太好了！

scripts.text:
[Kejulle Rekenber]
Hm? Sure, my last name
is Rekenber and that's the
same name as our chairman,
but that's just a coincidence.
I'm merely a normal employee.
Yeah, no special treatment...
scripts.translation:
[凯朱勒·雷肯贝尔]
嗯？我确实姓雷肯贝尔，跟我们董事长同姓，不过，只是巧合。
我就是个普通员工。没错，没有特殊待遇...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis man here
is motionless,
and for all intents
and purposes, is
soundly asleep.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这个男人一动不动，怎么看都像是睡得正香。^000000

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
What am I doing here?
Waiting for my dream
woman to fall into my lap,
what else does it look like?
scripts.translation:
[约书亚]
我在这儿干吗？当然是等梦中情人主动投怀送抱，还能干吗？

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
Tall, blond, creamy
complexion and smooth
skin. That's right. Come
right to Joshua, babes.
I got my pheromone spray
on and I'm ready to cruise~
scripts.translation:
[约书亚]
身材高挑，金发，肤色白皙，肌肤光滑。没错，宝贝们，快来找约书亚吧。
我已经喷好费洛蒙喷雾，准备猎艳了~

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
You know the men in
black suits? Boy, did
I get a scare! They actually
tracked me down to ask me
all these weird questions!
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
你知道那些穿黑西装的人吗？真把我吓坏了！他们竟然专门找上我，问了一堆古怪的问题！

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
They kept wanting to
know if I had ever met
anyone from the Rekenber
Corporation, if I've ever been
Uptown, that sort of thing. They
really scared the crap out of me.
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
他们一直追问我是否见过雷肯贝尔公司的人，是否去过上城区之类的问题。他们真的把我吓坏了。

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
Man, living in the
slums is such a drag.
Not only is life rough,
but all sorts of people
think they can push you
around. I hate Lighthalzen...
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
住在贫民窟真难熬。日子已经够苦了，什么人还都觉得能随便欺负你。
我讨厌里希塔乐镇...

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Whiskey!
I need me some
hard liquor now!
scripts.translation:
[哈加尔]
威士忌！我现在就要喝烈酒！

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Wha--? I didn't
order this stinkin'
rum! I want a man's
drink! Gimme whiskey!
scripts.translation:
[哈加尔]
什...什么？我可没点这破朗姆酒！我要喝男人该喝的酒！给我威士忌！

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey man, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿，伙计，我知道这里破破烂烂，快跟贫民窟一样了。可我们有全米德加尔特最好的朗姆酒，这就是我们的骄傲。
千真万确~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey lady, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿，女士，我知道这里破破烂烂，快跟贫民窟一样了。可我们有全米德加尔特最好的朗姆酒，这就是我们的骄傲。
千真万确~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Just a sip of this
beautiful drink and
you're on top of the
world! But it's best
for helpin' yah relax
and forget your worries.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
这美酒只要抿上一口，就能让你乐上天！不过，它最擅长的还是让人放松，忘掉烦恼。

scripts.text:
[Tony]
I don't take to bein'
a poet, but I do know
this. Our rum has the
sweet sweet flavor of
loneliness. You really
oughta try it when you can.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
我不是什么诗人，可我知道，我们的朗姆酒里有孤独的甜美滋味。
有机会一定要尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey! Hey you...!
D'you wanna, you
wanna hear me tell
you a joke?! It goes...
Um, it goes like this...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿！喂，你...！你想不想，想不想听我讲个笑话？！是这么说的...
呃，是这么说的...

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey riddle middle,
the cat and th--
No! No, damn it!
That's a song!
No, wait, that's
not a song either...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿，谜语叮当，猫和那——
不！不对，该死！那是首歌！
不，等等，那也不是歌...

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
*Hiccup* I loooove
this rum! I caught a cold
once and one glass made
it go away! 'Course, I slept
for a week too, but that don't
matter! Pshaw! Science...
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
*嗝* 我太——爱这朗姆酒了！有一回我感冒，喝一杯就好了！
当然，我也睡了整整一星期，可那不重要！哼！什么科学...

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
Oh, the flavor is just
so clean, but it's also
got a bit of a kick. I don't
know how to describe it.
Its the taste of happiness?
I'm too drunk to even tell!
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
哦，这味道真清爽，可后劲也不小。不知道该怎么形容。
是幸福的滋味？醉成这样，我也说不清了！

scripts.text:
[Assam]
This place is nice
and usually pretty quiet.
I like to come here after
work, have a drink and just
chat with the bartender.
scripts.translation:
[阿萨姆]
这里挺好，平时也安静。我喜欢下班后来喝一杯，跟调酒师聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Assam]
The rum here is incredibly
good too. It might even be
the best in the world. I dunno
why, but for some reason, its
taste reminds me of teamwork~
scripts.translation:
[阿萨姆]
这里的朗姆酒也特别好喝，也许是世界上最好的。
不知为什么，这味道总让我想起团队合作~

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
Oh, I'm only here
working as a waitress
to help out my father.
This job is so tiring, but
it's nice to see people so
relaxed and having a good time.
scripts.translation:
[兰科]
哦，我在这里当服务员，只是为了帮爸爸的忙。工作是挺累，不过，看见大家放松下来，玩得开心，也挺好的。

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
When I get some time
off, I'm going to explore
Lighthalzen and see all that
there is to see. But for now,
it doesn't look like we've got
any real shortage of drunks...
scripts.translation:
[兰科]
等有空了，我要好好逛逛里希塔乐镇，把能看的都看一遍。
可眼下，我们这里的醉鬼似乎一点也不缺...

scripts.text:
[Enku]
*Sob* I just got
dumped! Yeah, I thought
we were gonna get married,
but obviously I was wrong!
Damn it Sheryline! I loved you!
scripts.translation:
[恩库]
*呜呜* 我刚被甩了！我还以为我们会结婚，显然是我想错了！
该死，雪琳！我那么爱你！

scripts.text:
[Enku]
I usually don't care for
drinking, especially stuff
like gin or rum, but today,
this stuff tastes just like
my misery. This is all the
comfort I need, you hear?!
scripts.translation:
[恩库]
我平时不爱喝酒，尤其是金酒、朗姆酒这种。可今天，这酒的味道就像我的痛苦。
我只需要这种安慰，听见没有？！

scripts.text:
[Linus]
After ten years
of marriage. My
wife divorced me...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯]
结婚十年，我妻子跟我离婚了...

scripts.text:
[Linus]
So I guess there's no
place for me but here for
now. I don't know what it is,
but the rum is really good
today. Like, it's the flavor
of relaxing, joyous relief~
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯]
看来，眼下除了这儿，我也没别的地方可去了。
不知怎么回事，今天的朗姆酒特别好喝。就像轻松、快乐、如释重负的滋味~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
You know, everyone
is different, but I think
humans are similar enough
that we can all meaningfully
connect on some level, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
你知道吗，虽然每个人都不一样，但我认为人类在本质上足够相似，我们总能在某个层面上产生共鸣，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Sure, a rich person might
have different problems than
a poor person, but the point
is, they've both got problems!
Pain, pleasure, sadness, joy.
Those link us all together.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
没错，富人和穷人的烦恼可能不同，但重点是，他们都有烦恼！痛苦、快乐、悲伤、喜悦，这些情感将我们联系在一起。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
So try not to be picky
about who's your pal and
who's not. We all need
somebody to be with, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
所以，交朋友别太挑剔。我们都需要有人陪伴，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dique]
One of the things I look
forward to during my day
is the drink I enjoy right
after work. It's the most
relaxing thing in the world.
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
我每天最期待的事之一，就是下班后喝上一杯。那真是世上最让人放松的享受。

scripts.text:
[Dique]
Of course, there's
more to life than just
hanging out in pubs and
bars. The thing is, in my
case, pubs and bars are
all I happen to need~
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
当然，生活不仅仅是泡在酒吧里。不过对我来说，酒吧就是我需要的一切~

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
Do you know who I am?!
Just look at this peg leg.
I was in the Comodo War,
Ski Troop division! I lost my
leg to earn your freedom!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
你知道我是谁吗？！看看这条假腿。我参加过克魔岛战争，是滑雪部队的！我为了你们的自由失去了这条腿！

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
H-hey! What's that
look for? What, you
don't believe me?!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
喂...喂！你那是什么眼神？怎么，不信我？！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This is a
restricted area.
Please keep clear
if you do not have
special authorization.
Thank you for your cooperating.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这里是管制区域，没有特别许可，请勿靠近。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh phooey.
The same customers
are always coming in,
day after day. Can it
get any less exciting?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
唉，天天来的都是那几个老顾客。真是无聊透了。

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh...!
W-welcome~
C-can I help you
with anything?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
哦...！
欢...欢迎~
需...需要我为您做些什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Geonuii]
Greetings. This path
leads to the Library and
the Laboratory. Please be
aware that these places
are restricted from access
by the general public.
scripts.translation:
[格奴伊]
您好，这条路通往图书馆和实验室。请注意，这两个地方都不对公众开放。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie]
Oh no...
Where did I put it?
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
糟糕...
我把它放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
^3355FF(Whoa, it's a member
of the staff!)^000000 Good day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
^3355FF（哇，是职员！）^000000 您好！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This is a restricted
area! Please show
some ID immediately!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
这里是限制区域！请立即出示证件！

scripts.text: ID?
scripts.translation: 证件？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I don't know how you
adventurers do things in
Rune-Midgarts, but over here
we have laws about trespassing!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
我不知道你们冒险者在卢恩·米德加兹是怎么办事的，可我们这里擅闯禁区是违法的！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Unless you have special
authorization, nobody is
allowed into the Underground
Laboratory for security reasons.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
为了安全起见，没有特别许可，任何人都不得进入地下实验室。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Keep your eyes open.
I've heard rumors that some
adventurers from Rune-Midgarts
are trying to sneak into here!
I know the security here is
pretty much fail sure, but...
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
盯紧点！听说有些卢恩·米德加兹来的冒险者想偷偷潜入这里！
我知道这里的安保几乎万无一失，可是...

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This area is restricted
to the public! Who are you
and how did you get in here?!
Hey, I need backup right away!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
这里不对公众开放！你是谁，怎么进来的？！
喂，马上派人来支援！

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
No wonder these things
break all the time! These
machines have been totally
abused! Ugh, there's no
appreciation for all of this
convenient technology...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
难怪这些东西老坏！机器都被糟蹋成这样了！
唉，这些技术让人这么方便，怎么就没人珍惜呢...

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Yeah, all of this lab
equipment is really sensitive,
not to mention expensive. If
you ever handle this stuff, you
need to be extra cautious.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
没错，这些实验室设备都非常精密，而且价格昂贵。如果你要操作这些设备，必须格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Hey, you don't work--
G-guards! Hurry! There's
somebody over here!
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
嘿，你不在这里工作——
卫...卫兵！快过来！这里有人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace the other test
tube over here and then
clean the first test tube?
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
好，先从机器里取出一支试管，把这边另一支换上，然后清洗第一支试管？

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Or do I clean the test tube,
put it into the machine and
then replace the other one?
I'm so confused with this
procedure! If only I didn't
lose the instructions...
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
还是先洗试管，再放进机器，然后换另一支？
这流程真把我搞糊涂了！要是没弄丢说明书就好了...

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace th--hey. You're
not Ralphie. Wait. Guaaards!
Help me, there's some weirdo!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
好，先从机器里取出一支试管，再换——嘿，你不是拉尔菲。
等等！卫兵——！快来帮我，这儿有个怪人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Whoa whoa~!
Please! Don't
touch anything!
I'm dealing with highly
volatile chemicals here!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
喂喂~！拜托，什么都别碰！我正在处理极易挥发的化学品！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Guards! Hurry,
there's someone
here, and I think
it's one of those crazy
stalkers! Why, why me?!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
卫兵！快来，这里有人，我看是个疯狂的跟踪狂！
为什么，为什么偏偏找上我？！

scripts.text: Nice day, huh?
scripts.translation: 天气不错，是吧？

scripts.translation: 取消

...

...！

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Do you wish to
go underground?
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
您要去地下吗？

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
May I help you?
If you would like to
enter, you must first
have a Laboratory Permit.
Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
有什么可以帮您？如需进入，请先出示研究所进出卡片。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
谢谢，祝您一天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
谢谢，祝您一天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Arthur]
The chairs here are
so not ergonomic. And
they're uncomfortable too!
But it's sooo cool inside this
bank and I just wanted to get
get away from all this heat...
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟]
这里的椅子一点也不符合人体工学，坐着还不舒服！
可银行里真凉快，我只是想躲躲外面的热气...

scripts.text:
[Helen]
You know, maybe when
I grow up, I'll be a bank
clerk. That sounds like a
really nice job, don't you
think? It's laid back and posh...
scripts.translation:
[海伦]
你知道吗，也许等我长大了，我会成为一名银行职员。听起来是一份很棒的工作，你觉得呢？工作轻松又体面...

scripts.text:
[Tadem]
I do so enjoy the
architectural structure
of this bank. It's quite
artistic with both classical
and modern elements. Would
you not agree? Fascinating...
scripts.translation:
[塔德姆]
我非常欣赏这家银行的建筑结构。它兼具古典与现代元素，颇具艺术感。您不觉得吗？真是迷人...

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
Oh, it's so comfortable
in here~ Though, why are
we inside the bank when
the bank services aren't even
working? Yes, we're standing,
but we're doing it in comfort.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
哦，这里真舒服~可是，银行业务都暂停了，我们干吗还待在里面呢？
没错，我们是站着，可站得也很舒服呀。

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
In fact, it's so
comfortable here,
I think I'll refuse to leave.
Though, I'm willing to change
my mind if you can find a place
that's even more comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
这里实在太舒服了，我都不想走。不过，要是你能找到更舒服的地方，我倒愿意改主意。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Due to some critical system
errors, all of the bank services
have been temporarily stopped.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
由于系统出现严重故障，银行所有业务暂时停止。
给您带来不便，我们深表歉意，感谢您的理解。

scripts.text:
[Togii]
Oooh yeah...
Goes down smooth.
Morocc whiskey's the best!
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Whoa, this stuff
really works fast! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[托吉]
哦，真不错...入喉顺滑。莫洛克的威士忌最棒了！
^333333*嗝*^000000 哇，这酒劲来得真快！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Healthy Looking Guy]
Grrrrrr! Leave me alone!
How many times do I have
to keep telling you? I've never
hoarded item upgrade materials!
I swear that I'm innocent!
scripts.translation:
[看起来很健康的家伙]
可恶！别烦我了！到底还要说多少遍？我从没囤积过装备精炼材料！
我发誓，我是清白的！

scripts.text:
[Hinkley]
Meh heh heh...
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Believe
it or notsh, I'm...
walkin on a... Air...
Nevah thought I could
b-be sho freee-eeee-eee~
scripts.translation:
[欣克利]
嘿嘿嘿...
^333333*嗝*^000000 信不信由你，我...正踩着...空气...走呢...
没想到能这...这么自——由——呀~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis guy
is completely
hammered out
of his mind!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这家伙已经醉得神志不清了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Millette]
Let me go!
Let me GO!!
LET ME GO!!!
I didn't do nuthin'
wrong! I'm innocent!
^333333*Hic-Hic-Hiccup...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[米莱特]
放开我！
放开我啊！！
放开我！！！
我没做错任何事！我是清白的！
^333333*嗝-嗝-嗝...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Millette]
What's wrong with
drinking and singing
in the street, huh?
Is it a crime to have
a beautiful tenor voice?!
Get me outta this joint!
scripts.translation:
[米莱特]
在街上喝酒唱歌有什么不对吗？
拥有优美的男高音嗓音也是犯罪吗？！
快把我从这鬼地方放出去！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
Tell me...!
TELL ME...!!
Admit you did it!!
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
说...！快说...！！承认是你干的！！

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
Damn it!
I keep telling
you I'm not guilty!
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
该死！说了多少遍，我没罪！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000

[Suspect]
You're wasting your
time. Just let me go.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
你这是白费工夫。放我走吧。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
So...
How's your mother?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
那么...你母亲还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
That's none of
your business!
She's fine, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
这不关你的事！
她应该没事吧。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
When was the last
time you've seen her?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
你最后一次见到她是什么时候？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
I just told you,
that's none of
your business...!
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
刚才都说了，不关你的事...！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
You know, mothers
throughout the animal
kingdom instinctively
care for their young.
Humans are no exception.
Yours must be worried to death.
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
动物的母亲都会本能地照顾自己的孩子，人类也不例外。
你母亲一定担心坏了。

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
...
Man...
You're starting
to weird me out.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
...
老兄...你说得我心里直发毛。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
Funny thing about humans,
though. It seems to be their
nature to lie, even when they
know they'll be caught. But
like all animals, they
instinctively fear pain...
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
不过，人类也挺有意思。明知会被揭穿，还是要撒谎，仿佛这是天性。
可他们跟所有动物一样，本能地害怕疼痛...

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
N-no, no...
You gotta be...
You're bluffing.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
不...不...你肯定是...
你在吓唬我，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
NO.
You're bluffing.
Tell me...!
TELL ME...!!
Admit you did it!!
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
不，是你在虚张声势。
说...！快说...！！承认是你干的！！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
This Banquet Hall is used
to hold events such as dinner
parties with partners, clients
and other associates, and press
conferences. Of course, there's
nothing going on right now.
scripts.translation:
[宴会工作人员]
这个宴会厅用来举办招待合作伙伴、客户等宾客的晚宴，也会举办新闻发布会。
当然，现在没有活动。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
Sometimes peace and quiet
is a welcome change of pace,
but right now I'm feeling quite
bored. I think I would rather
be busy than twiddling my
thumbs, to tell the truth.
scripts.translation:
[宴会工作人员]
偶尔清静一下，确实不错。可眼下我实在无聊。
说真的，比起闲得无所事事，我宁愿忙一点。

scripts.text:
[Luccet]
Shhhh! Hey, my brother's
''it,'' so I gotta find a place
to hide! Wait, would you just
stand really still? I could
just hide behind you! No?
Nuts! Olly olly oxen free!
scripts.translation:
[卢塞特]
嘘！哥哥在找人，我得找个地方躲起来！
等等，你能站着别动吗？我躲在你身后就行！不行？
讨厌！不玩啦，大家都出来吧！

scripts.text:
[Hanccet]
Man... I hate being ''it!''
I'm horrible at this game!
Alright, okay, if I were my
sister Luccet, where would
I think I would not look for
me? Of course...! The sewers!
scripts.translation:
[汉塞特]
唉...我最讨厌当找人的那个！这游戏我玩得太差了！
好，想想，要是我是妹妹卢塞特，会躲在哪个我想不到的地方呢？
当然是...下水道！

scripts.text:
[Annette]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Banquet Hall
is also used to hold weddings.
That must be so wonderful~
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
听说雷肯贝尔宴会厅也会举办婚礼，一定很美好吧~

scripts.text:
[Annette]
Even if it is more expensive,
I'd want to have my wedding
here. Marriage is only once
in a lifetime, ideally, so I'd
want to make mine the most
memorable experience.
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
就算贵一点，我也想在这里办婚礼。理想的话，人一辈子只结一次婚嘛。
所以，我希望自己的婚礼能成为最难忘的回忆。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Shhhhhhzzzz*
*Shhhhhhzzzz*^000000

[Mereth]
Shhhhh....
Aaaaaaaahhh...
scripts.translation:
[梅雷斯]
嘘...
啊哈...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe employee turned his
head and peered into your
eyes through the black mask
on his face. Mereth stared
wordlessly for a moment and
then began to dance a lively,
creepily jovial jig.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那名职员转过头，透过脸上的黑色面具盯着你的双眼。梅雷斯默默看了你片刻，随后跳起一支欢快的小舞，欢快得有些诡异。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is simply a pile
of files, a smattering of
books and a family portrait.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里只是一堆文件、几本书和一幅全家福。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk is very
neat and well organized
in comparison to the other
desks you've seen in your
time. You take a moment to
fully marvel at its tidiness.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF比起你见过的其他办公桌，这张桌子格外整洁，摆放井然有序。你不禁驻足片刻，赞叹它的整齐。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk has a bookshelf
that is crammed with all sorts
of books. Out of curiosity, you
decide to pick one out.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这张桌子配有一个书架，塞满了各种书籍。出于好奇，你决定抽出一本看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, the book you
happen to touch contains
an amazing amount of dark
power, causing you to drop it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF然而，你碰到的那本书蕴含着惊人的黑暗力量，令你失手将它掉了下去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Noama]
Hee hee~!
You wanna hear
something funny?
I heard there's a bar in
Prontera where this guy
sneaks singles into Jawa--
scripts.translation:
[诺阿玛]
嘿嘿~！想听件有趣的事吗？
听说普隆德拉有间酒吧，有个家伙会偷偷把单身的人送进爪哇——

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Noama...!
These machines are
acting up again! Get
over here right now!
scripts.translation:
[马兹翁]
诺阿玛...！这些机器又出毛病了！马上过来！

scripts.text:
[Noama]
What?!
Stop bugging me,
I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[诺阿玛]
什么？！别烦我，我什么也没干！

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Crap. Crap! Crap
crap crap crap crap!
These desk machines aren't
supposed to work like this!
scripts.translation:
[马兹翁]
糟了，糟了！糟了糟了糟了糟了糟了！
这些桌上的机器不该这样运转啊！

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Noama...!
These machines are
acting up again! Get
over here right now!
scripts.translation:
[马兹翁]
诺阿玛...！这些机器又出毛病了！马上过来！

scripts.text:
[Noama]
What?!
Stop bugging me,
I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[诺阿玛]
什么？！别烦我，我什么也没干！

scripts.text:
[Mareth]
Yoo hoo hoo~
Oh, how I love
love love chocolate!
scripts.translation:
[马雷斯]
哟呵呵~哦，我最最最喜欢巧克力了！

scripts.text:
[Mareth]
Eat it up...
Or just melt it.
Slather it all over me.
Booyah. New life aspiration.
scripts.translation:
[马雷斯]
把它吃光...或者干脆化开，涂满我全身。
太棒了，这就是我的新人生目标。

scripts.text:
[Eiya]
Jorje seems so cranky
recently. He's usually
more laid back than this.
Oh well, I hope that he
feels better.
scripts.translation:
[英也]
约尔赫最近似乎很烦躁。
他平时没这么急躁的。
算了，希望他能好起来。

scripts.text:
[Eiya]
Ooh, would you like
to look at my miniature
doll collection? I love
collecting cute dolls!
scripts.translation:
[英也]
哦，想看看我收藏的迷你娃娃吗？我最喜欢收集可爱的娃娃了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found a blackboard
filled with scribbling. You
can only read some of the
messages that have been
quickly scrawled on it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一块写满涂鸦的黑板。
你只能看清其中一些匆忙写下的留言。^000000

is complete by XX 00.''
- Jorje
scripts.translation:
“务必在 XX 00 前完成全部工作。”
——约尔赫

scripts.text:
[Rocky]
Woof woof!
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[Rocky]
Grrrrrrr...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
呜呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Jay]
My mommy and daddy
always come home late.
So I eat dinner alone.
All by myself. Everyday.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊]
爸爸妈妈总是很晚才回家。所以我都是一个人吃晚饭。
就我自己，每天都是。

scripts.text:
[Jay]
Food doesn't taste as
good when you're not
eating with anybody.
Maybe I'm just lonely.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊]
一个人吃饭，食物好像没那么好吃了。
也许...我只是有点孤单。

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Jane]
This house is enormous...
It's clearly much too big
for a regularly sized family.
And it takes me forever to
make sure that it stays clean!
scripts.translation:
[女仆 简]
这房子真大...普通一家人住，明显太大了。光是把它保持干净，就得花我好多时间！

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Jane]
It's not easy keeping
things neat and tidy when
you're responsible for acres
of indoor living space. Being
a maid can be pretty hard...
scripts.translation:
[女仆 简]
这么大片室内空间，全归我打理，想保持整洁可不容易。做女仆真辛苦...

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Brenda]
I better dust extra
gently around this vase.
It's worth ten million zeny
and if it were to-- No. No!
I'm not even going to think it!
scripts.translation:
[女仆 布伦达]
给这花瓶掸灰，可得格外轻手轻脚。它值一千万 Zeny，要是——
不，不行！我连想都不敢想！

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Down there, the repairman
is just finishing maintenance
on our chairman's private
Airship. Can you imagine
having one of those of your
very own to fly around in?
scripts.translation:
[贝纳图斯]
下面的修理工，正快要给董事长的私人飞空艇做完保养。
你能想象拥有一艘自己的飞空艇，想飞哪儿就飞哪儿吗？

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Yeah, the chairman of
the Rekenber Corporation...
He's a really powerful person.
It's almost scary what he can
do with his money, you know?
scripts.translation:
[贝纳图斯]
没错，就是雷肯贝尔公司的董事长...他可是个有权有势的人。
有那么多钱，他能做的事简直让人害怕，你明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Dude, check it out~
Official glossy photos
of the Kafra Ladies. Now...
With 20% more garter belts!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
哥们，快看~卡普拉小姐们的官方亮面写真。
现在...吊袜带多了 20%！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
So they're all wearing
garter belts in these?
Whoa, that means they
even got the glasses chick
to wear 'em too? That's the
best news I've heard all day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
所以，这里面她们全都穿着吊袜带？哇，连戴眼镜的那个也穿了？
这可是我今天听到的最好消息！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Okay man, you know these
are limited edition collector's
items, so each one is worth
300,000 zeny. I mean, I have
an extra set, but I don't know
if you'd wanna buy them off--
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
老兄，你知道这些是限量收藏品，每张都值 300,000 Zeny。
我倒是多了一套，不过，不知道你想不想买——

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
I'll take them all.
Wait, all of them except
for that young kid. Just the
idea of having her glamour
photo around strikes me as...
Yeah. Yeah, it's no good.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
我全要了。等等，那个小女孩的不要。
光是想到收藏她的写真，就觉得...嗯，嗯，这不合适。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Whoa, whoa. Now this...
This is art. The lighting,
the angle, the... the...
subject matter. Oh yes.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
哇，哇。这个...这才叫艺术。光线，角度，还有...还有...拍摄对象。
哦，没错。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Man, these officially licensed
Kafra Lady glossies... They're
worth every zeny we paid. Say
goodbye Swimsuit Calendar,
and hellooooo Kafra Leilah~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
老兄，这些官方授权的卡普拉小姐亮面写真，花的每一分 Zeny 都值！
再见，泳装日历。你好——卡普拉莱拉~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Leilah? Oh, you mean
the glasses chick? Dude...
Dude. She's my favorite too!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
莱拉？哦，就是戴眼镜的那个？老兄...老兄，我也最喜欢她！

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Sometimes the simple
pleasures can give you
the most happiness. For me,
going outside and basking in
the sun is the greatest thing~
scripts.translation:
[黛尔娜]
有时候，最简单的乐趣反而最让人幸福。对我来说，出门晒晒太阳，就是最棒的享受~

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Yes, sunbathing in a quiet
and relaxing place can be
so refreshing. And if you're
careful about not getting a
sunburn or a tan, a little sun
can be really good for you.
scripts.translation:
[黛尔娜]
是啊，找个安静舒适的地方晒太阳，真让人神清气爽。
只要留意别晒伤、晒黑，适当晒一点，对身体很有好处。

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
Curses...
I've come to the
wrong place to seek
out a challenge. No
one here is really all
that mighty or competitive!
scripts.translation:
[武术家]
该死...想找人挑战，我真是来错地方了。这里根本没什么强手，也没几个人好胜！

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
This whole city thinks
it can buy power and safety
with money. They don't know
the value of a nice, friendly
brawl. Hopefully, I'll find a
rival around here soon...
scripts.translation:
[武术家]
这城里的人都觉得，钱能买来力量和安全。他们根本不懂，痛痛快快地切磋一场有多好。
希望能早点在这里找到对手...

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
This city might have
more guards and rules
than other places, but
I still don't know if it's
really safe to live here.
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
这城里的卫兵和规矩可能比别处都多，可我还是不知道，住这里是不是真的安全。

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
I mean, the reason we have
these rules is because of all
the unruly gangsters that can
sometimes get into the city.
I mean, it's relatively peaceful and all. But these rules...
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
这些规矩，都是为了防那些有时会混进城里的流氓。这里是挺太平的，可这些规矩...

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
It's good to be safe,
but I don't know if it's
a good idea to sacrifice
our freedoms or standard
of living, you know?
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
安全是好事，可为了安全牺牲我们的自由和生活水准，真值得吗？

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Oh, you youngsters.
Always traveling around
and having adventures and
fighting monsters. I certainly
had my fill of excitement back
when I was your age, long ago.
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
哦，你们年轻人，总在到处旅行、冒险、打魔物。我像你这么大时，也没少经历刺激的事。
那可是多少年前了。

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Sure, I miss doing all
of that, but now I'm content
with just relaxing and resting.
Still, there are a lot of old folk who refuse to sit still like this~
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
当然，我也怀念那些日子，不过，现在能歇着放松就很满足了。
可也有不少老人，不肯像我这样安静坐着~

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
Granny may be happy
just sitting around and
enjoying the peaceful life,
but I'm not! I'm too young
to just lay down and let
these days just pass by!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕尔]
奶奶可能觉得坐着享清福就很开心，可我不行！我还年轻，不能躺着让日子白白过去！

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
I wanna make something
of myself. Maybe someday,
I'll found a company as big
as the Rekenber Corporation!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕尔]
我要干出一番事业。说不定哪天，也能创办一家跟雷肯贝尔公司一样大的企业！

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
Unlike most places,
Lighthalzen has many
beautiful clothing and
accessory shops. This
place is heaven to a
trend-setter like me~!
scripts.translation:
[金米]
里希塔乐镇和别处不同，有好多漂亮的服装店、饰品店。
像我这样引领潮流的人，来这里简直就像到了天堂~！

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
I don't know if you
adventurers are interested
in fashion, but you can trash
your old clothes and get some
new, unique and trendy gear
over here in Lighthalzen~
scripts.translation:
[金米]
不知道你们冒险者对时尚有没有兴趣，不过，旧衣服可以扔啦！
来里希塔乐镇，换些新颖独特、又时髦的行头吧~

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
Another hungry day...
I don't have any money
and even if I did, there's
no place that sells food
I'd actually eat. Oh, man.
I'm barely living as it is.
scripts.translation:
[博杰]
又要饿一天...我没钱，就算有，也没地方卖我想吃的东西。
唉，能勉强活下去就不错了。

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
I hear that the people
who live Uptown eat totally
delicious, gourmet food eight
times a day! Hopefully it's just an exaggeration. 'Cuz if it
wasn't, I'd be so mad...
scripts.translation:
[博杰]
听说上城区的人，一天能吃八顿山珍海味！希望只是夸张的说法。
不然，我真要气死了...

scripts.text:
[Avetis]
A-ack...
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Would you give me
some m-medicine?!
^333333*Cough cough haack*^000000
Sweet Christmas, it hurts...

[Avetis]
I sk-skipped work
because I've been too
sick t-to go. ^333333*Cough*^000000
But now I don't have
the money to ^333333*Haack*^000000
buy med-medicine...

[Diana]
Oh wow, that weapon
is fantastic! But I'm sure
that it must be really
expensive. Huh...
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哇，那武器真棒！不过，肯定贵得很吧。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ma'am, are you talking
about this Stiletto? You
certainly have an eye for
quality weapons. If you
don't mind me asking,
where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[店员]
女士，您说的是这把匕首吗？您可真会挑好武器。
冒昧问一句，您从哪里来？

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, I was born
and raised in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哦，我是土生土长的莫洛克人。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ah yes, I've heard many
good things about that town.
You've certainly proven that
people from Morocc truly have
good taste. Now, this Stiletto
is a steal at 39,800 zeny...
scripts.translation:
[店员]
啊，听说那是个好地方。您果然证明了，莫洛克人很有品味。
这把匕首只卖 39,800 Zeny，实在划算...

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Huh...?!
That's ridiculous!
Never mind that, let
me take a look at that
Gladius in the corner.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
什么...？！贵得太离谱了！
算了，给我看看角落里那把短剑。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
The Gladius?
Ah, that would be
39,800 zeny, ma'am.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
短剑？女士，那把也是 39,800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, that's a really
good price. I'll take it!
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哦，这价格真不错。我买了！

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Yes, this replica really
does look just like an
actual Gladius, does it
not? Although not a true
weapon, it's quite capable of
opening the toughest envelopes.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
没错，这件仿制品看起来跟真正的短剑一模一样，不是吗？
虽然不能当武器，可用来拆再难拆的信封都没问题。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
...
......
I take that back.
This shop really sucks.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
...
......
我收回刚才的话。这家店真烂。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Welcome to our
store where we offer
many unique products that
you can't find anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
欢迎光临。本店有许多独家商品，别处可买不到。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
However, shopping is only available to our members. There's an annual
membership fee that's waived when you spend a certain amount every
month in our store. If you invite your friends, you'll receive spe--
scripts.translation:
[店员]
不过，本店只接受会员购物。会员需要缴纳年费，每月消费达到一定金额，就可免除年费。
如果邀请朋友加入，还能获得特——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
N-no thank you!
I'm not interested!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...不用了，谢谢！我没兴趣！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
You know, there's an
interesting story about
the axe that's hanging
over there. Would you
like me to tell you?
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
挂在那边的斧头，有个有趣的故事。要不要听我讲讲？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
This previous owner of
this Weapon Shop was
a convicted serial killer.
Each night, he'd take that
axe and cruelly murder
beautiful ladies like me.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
这家武器店的前任店主，是个被定罪的连环杀人犯。
每到夜里，他就拿着那把斧头，残忍地杀害像我这样美丽的女人。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
When he was finally
caught, they beheaded
him with his own axe.
Since then, they say that
his ghost still lingers and
sharpens this axe at night.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
他最终被抓住后，人们用他自己的斧头砍下了他的头。
据说，从那以后，他的鬼魂就一直徘徊不去，夜里还会来磨这把斧头。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Just thinking about
it gives me goosebumps!
And I'm supposed to work
here! It's so creepy!
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
光想想就起鸡皮疙瘩！我还得在这里工作！太吓人了！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Oh, how disappointing~
It's the perfect story for
the season. Well, now that
I think about it, that story is
actually pretty creepy...
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
哦，真扫兴~这个故事最适合在这季节讲了。
不过，仔细想想，它确实挺吓人的...

scripts.text:
[Srinivas]
Those rundown buildings
in the slums are an eyesore
that offend the entire city!
I just wish they would wreck
them down. What do I care
about the poor and needy?
scripts.translation:
[斯里尼瓦斯]
贫民窟那些破楼真碍眼，简直给整座城丢脸！真希望全拆了。
那些穷人会怎么样？关我什么事？

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Corporation
actually created the
environment in Lighthalzen
through artificial means.
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
听说里希塔乐镇的环境，其实是雷肯贝尔公司用人工手段营造出来的。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
It seems like it'd take
a lot of investment, but
artificially creating an
environment isn't impossible
with the means available to
the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
这应该需要很大一笔投入。不过，凭雷肯贝尔公司的能力，人工营造环境也并非不可能。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Still, it's pretty
depressing to think
that the beauty of nature
can be man-made and
equated to zeny, you know?
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
^333333*唉...*^000000
可一想到自然之美竟能人工制造，还能用 Zeny 衡量，就觉得很沮丧，你懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
The weather is so
nice today, like always.
I just want to ditch work,
run outside and work out.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
今天天气还是那么好。我真想翘班，跑到外面去锻炼。

scripts.text: Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation: 你想去哪里？

scripts.text: But shouldn't you go to work?
scripts.translation: 但你不是该去上班吗？

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你听说过连环杀手吗？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Well, those guys in
black suits, not to mention
the ruffians that manage to
invade town, sometimes sort
of make it kind of unsafe to
go out all by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
嗯，那些穿黑西装的家伙，还有那些闯进镇上的流氓，有时候让你一个人出门确实不太安全。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
But me and a buddy are
planning to head to the
Al De Baran Turbo Track
one of these days. Boy,
the last time we went,
he wasted a lot of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
不过，我和一个朋友打算哪天去艾尔帕兰涡轮赛道。上回去，他可是花了不少 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
He actually won some
kind of potion as a prize
and let me have it. I drank
it and it made me move really
slowly. Now what kind of prize
is that supposed to be?!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
他赢了一瓶什么药水，就送给我了。我喝完以后，动作变得特别慢。
这到底算哪门子奖品？！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I think my buddy
was totally scammed.
That, or I was totally
tricked by him to drink it.
How they came up with such a ridiculous idea for a prize!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
我觉得我朋友肯定被骗了。要么，就是他骗我喝那东西。
他们怎么会想出这么离谱的奖品！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Wha--?! I didn't say
I was going to ditch work,
I just said I wanted to!
But just to spite you, maybe
just maybe, I won't go today!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
什么？！我没说要翘班，只是说想翘班！
不过，为了气你，说不定，我今天还真就不去了！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Then again, I don't
think I can slack on
this project. Curses...
The weekend certainly
doesn't come fast enough!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
可话说回来，这项目还真不能偷懒。该死...
周末怎么还不来啊！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
What, you mean that
axe murderer from a long
time ago? Well, I heard a
rumor that it actually wasn't
like that. Let's see, how
did the story go?
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
什么，你是说很久以前那个斧头杀手？嗯，我听说其实情况不是那样的。让我想想，故事是怎么说的？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I heard that some hat
maker, the one who makes
the Smokie Hat, accidentally
made a Person Headgear
instead of, like, a hat made
of monsters. Don't ask me how.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
听说有个做狸猫帽子的帽匠，本来要做魔物造型的帽子，却不小心做出了人形头饰。
别问我是怎么弄的。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Yeah, I think relatives
of that Airship Captain...
They were totally made into
a hat on accident. Supposedly,
it looks like a Reindeer Head,
but now that's just too weird.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
对，好像是那位飞空艇船长的亲戚...竟然被意外做成了帽子。
据说看起来像驯鹿头，可这也太怪了。

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Arrrgh, I don't
have any time for
talking! I'm in the
middle of an important
task! H-hold on a second!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
啊...我没时间聊天！我正在执行重要任务！等...等一下！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
D-don't come any
closer! Anyone who
comes near me might
just screw me up! Back off!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
别...别靠近！谁凑过来，都可能把我的事搞砸！退后！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Oh man...
I've been working so
hard and haven't taken
any breaks. I think I'll
reward myself and buy
something like maybe--
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
唉...我这么卖力工作，连休息都没有。该犒劳一下自己，买点东西，比如——

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
No! No, I'm not
gonna buy anything!
I've got my future wife
to think about! Must...
Save... More... Money!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
不！不，什么都不买！我还得为未来的妻子打算！
必须...存...更多...钱！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh...!
Good heavens!
Um, may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
哦...！
天哪！
嗯，有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh, you're an Assassin!
Oh, you boys are soooo cute!
And so cool and so mysterious all at the same time! I love you!
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
哦，你是刺客！你们男孩子太可爱了！又酷，又神秘！我爱死你们了！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
An Assassin...?
Oh, you wouldn't happen
to know any Assassin boys
that might be single, do you?
Oh-my-god, they're hunky-hot~
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
刺客...？你有没有认识的单身刺客男孩？
天哪，他们又壮又帅，太迷人了~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...?
That sound. Did...
Did someone just
take my picture?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么...？那声音，难道...刚才有人给我拍照？

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Welcome to the
temporary headquarters
of Cool Event Corporation.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
欢迎来到酷事件公司的临时总部。今天有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Temporary headquarters?
scripts.translation: 临时总部？

scripts.text: Voting
scripts.translation: 投票

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Our headquarters building
is currently undergoing
reconstruction, so we are
basing our operations in
this place for the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
总部大楼目前正在改建，因此，我们暂时在这里办公。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
目前，卡普拉公司与酷事件公司正在合作推出直达地下城的传送服务。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting our valued customers to choose the company they want.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
由于技术限制，两家公司不能同时提供前往同一地下城的传送服务。因此，我们将挑选部分客户，让他们选择希望由哪家公司提供服务。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Only a limited number of
voters will be chosen, so
you can check your voting
eligibility at the headquarters
of both participating companies. Thank you for your patronage~
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
只有部分客户会被选为投票者。您可以到参与合作的两家公司总部，查询自己是否有投票资格。
感谢您的惠顾~

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
目前，卡普拉公司与酷事件公司正在合作推出直达地下城的传送服务。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting a number of valued customers to vote for their choice.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
由于技术限制，两家公司不能同时提供前往同一地下城的传送服务。因此，我们将邀请部分客户投票，选择希望由哪家公司提供服务。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
I've just reviewed your
information and would like
to inform you that you are
indeed eligible to vote.
Your participation in this
election is much appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
刚刚核对了您的资料，您确实拥有投票资格。
非常感谢您参与此次投票。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Remember that the
election polls can be
found in either Prontera
or Juno. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
请记得，投票处设在普隆德拉和朱诺。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Thank you.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
谢谢，祝您一天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I don't like this.
But I don't like that
idea either. What will
I do for a new event, eh?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉林]
这个不喜欢，那个主意也不喜欢。新的活动到底该怎么做呢？

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I need something
major, something that'll
really shake up the world,
something epochal, but what?
Hey, do you have any ideas?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉林]
我要来个大手笔，能震撼世界、开创时代的活动。可到底是什么呢？
喂，你有没有主意？

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
Hmmm...
The employees seem
to be having too much
fun amongst themselves
recently. This does not
bode well at all...
scripts.translation:
[包托]
嗯...最近员工们凑在一起，玩得太开心了。这可不是好兆头...

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
It looks like I'm
just going to have to
start cracking that whip
more often and much
harder. Ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[包托]
看来，得更频繁、更严厉地督促他们了。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
Ack! I'm totally
swamped with all this
work! But I don't wanna
do any of it. That's it!
I totally need a break.
scripts.translation:
[塞苏娜]
啊！这么多工作，忙都忙不过来！可我一个都不想做。
决定了！我非得歇一歇不可。

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I wonder if Saera
would ever consider
going out with me?
That would be nice~
scripts.translation:
[塞苏娜]
^333333*唉...*^000000
不知道赛拉愿不愿意跟我约会？要是愿意，该多好啊~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
Greetings. As part of our
effort to relieve the poor,
Rekenber is providing job
opportunities targeted for
citizens of the slum areas.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔员工]
您好，为了帮助贫困居民，雷肯贝尔公司正在为贫民窟的市民提供工作机会。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
You can choose to work
from home, or undergo a
little bit of training for more
professional positions. This
is a great chance to make a
difference... and some money~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔员工]
您可以选择在家工作，也可以接受一些培训，从事更专业的工作。
这是改变生活...顺便赚点钱的好机会~

scripts.text:
[A Scientist]
What happened? All the machines are ruined and the research report are gone! The history of Regenschirm has been hacked!
scripts.translation:
[一位科学家]
出什么事了？机器全毁了，研究报告也没了！雷根席尔姆的历史记录遭到了黑客攻击！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
It takes so long for
this device to process
all the data and give me
the results. Still, the wait
heightens my anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
这台设备处理所有数据并给出结果需要很长时间。不过，等待反而让我更加期待...

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
What?! Guards!
Hurry, there's an
intruder right here!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
什么？！卫兵！
快过来，这里有个入侵者！
